description: Start at the top of a movie or episode Details page with known Plex Director metadata. Repeat for a series supplying Director metadata and for missing/Writer-only credits; do not activate playback or account actions.

steps.name: 01-director-credit
steps.review: People column above Starring shows supplied director names without overlap. A series credit is explicitly scoped to the series when the hero shows an episode synopsis. Writer-only metadata says Written by, never invents a creator/director. Missing credits omit the heading. Existing crew tiles still open the shared person page.
